why_live_data: Turim's revenue lead calls online rate parity 'the single biggest challenge' with inventory 'accessible across dozens of channels', so without live rate data it cannot see when a third-party platform undercuts its direct rate across its roughly 25 hotels.

Roiback page also names Ricardo Neves Vieira, Commercial Executive Director ('compete on equal terms with the large OTAs'), undated. Pipeline openings on site ('Opening 2026' Sintra) have no announcement date: not staged. Minor launches (refurbishment 2025-08-12, restaurant 2025-11-18) not staged.
